Apex / Enterprise systems

Operational control for a new generation of screens.

Modernizing a platform for accounts, clients and point-of-use devices.

UX/UI DesignJuan Carvajal
THE STARTING POINT

Apex

Trajectory applications had been conceived for desktop use. The shift toward tablets and phones required rethinking structure, interaction and responsiveness.

PROJECT CONTEXT
01 / The challenge02 / The solution03 / Decisions04 / The impact
01

The challenge

Modernize a legacy enterprise experience while preserving the capabilities needed to manage devices, configuration and accounts.

02

The solution

Building on research provided by Apex, the team developed flows, wireframes and specifications for Lunar Journey UI Core App, covering accounts, clients, POU devices and updates.

03

Decisions that make the difference

01

Use existing research as the starting point.

02

Structure relationships between accounts, clients and devices.

03

Pair wireframes with implementable specifications.

04 / The impact

From desktop to a responsive experience

A responsive web application bringing administration and support tasks into an updated interface. The case publishes no quantitative outcome metrics.
